decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Location Plan No CH245/3703/P1, Drawing Nos. CH245/3443/P1-Second Floor Plan (existing), CH245/3413/P6-Second Floor Plan proposed, CH245/3454/P1-Second Floor Terrace Details (Sheet 3), CH245/3450/P1-Flat B7 Plot 72 Second Floor Extension, CH245/3414/P1-Roof Plan Proposed, CH245/3444/P1-North Elevation Existing, CH245/3420/P4-Proposed North Elevation, CH245/3445/P1-West Elevation (existing), CH245/3421/P3-Proposed West Elevation, CH245/3422/P4-Proposed East Elevation, CH245/3446/P1-East Elevation (existing), Planning Statement by Boyer Planning dated June 2011, Barter Hill Partnership Ltd - Structural Assessment Report dated 27 May 2011. All received 02/08/11) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials used in the development shall be in accordance with those on approved application 01119/M/P6 Drawing CH455/507 REV B Schedule of External Materials and the accompanying samples of Reconstituted Bath Stone received 23/09/10 and Ibstock Queensbury Yellow Multi-Stock brick received 23/11/10
description: Proposed erection of a single storey extension to second floor residential apartment on existing roof terrace of Campion House, in association with conversion works.
